title: NO SHOT ON TARGET, A POLITE TRICKLE OF A GOAL. NEWCASTLE BOOED.
description:
No shot on target in the first half, and Newcastle still got booed. It got worse.

Thierno Barry scored in the 49th minute after a shot squirmed under the keeper. Not a thunderbolt. A polite trickle. Ugly goals count the same, and it was Everton's first away league win of the season.

Jacob Ramsey was sent off late for two yellows in 86 seconds. Some people take longer to order a coffee. It was Newcastle's second straight home loss and fourth defeat in five games. They sit thirteenth. Only the volume is rising.

Matthias Jaissle took the blame and said they must improve. The crowd had already reached the same conclusion.

Are the boos fair, or is Jaissle being too hard on himself? Pick a side below.
